name: Hopewell Ceremonial Earthworks
description: Eight sets of grass-covered earthen walls across southern Ohio, built roughly 1,600 to 2,000 years ago by the Hopewell people, form perfect circles, squares and octagons, some enclosing hilltop plazas levelled by hand. Their walls line up with the Sun and the Moon's complex cycles. Ritual objects found here were crafted from materials brought from far across the continent.
